map.地形图比例尺与图上/实际距离的相互换算: Mutual conversion between topographic-map scale and map/ground distances
map.图上长 = 实地长 / 比例尺分母: Map length = ground length / scale denominator
map.公式：实际距离 = 图上距离 × 比例尺分母 N；图上距离 = 实际距离 / N: Formula: ground distance = map distance × scale denominator N; map distance = ground distance / N. Common units: 1 km = 1000 m = 100000 cm.
map.图上距 ↔ 实地距按比例尺互转。: Convert map distance ↔ ground distance by scale.
map.图距=实距/分母、实距=图距×分母，单位统一到 m 再算。: Map distance = ground / denominator, ground = map × denominator; unify to m before computing.
map.1:n 即图上 1 单位=实地 n 单位，n 越大图越小越概略。: 1:n means 1 unit on map = n units on ground; larger n means a smaller, more general map.
map.面积比=比例尺平方，1:1000 图上 1cm²=实地 100 m²。: Area ratio = scale squared; on 1:1000, 1 cm² on map = 100 m² on ground.
map.比例尺换算是一款科学研究领域的在线工具。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准: Scale Conversion is an online tool in the scientific research domain. A scientific tool using standard scientific formulas for accurate computation.
